# Daily Report — 2026-08-17

## Task Completed
Added ServiceNow metric/gauge tools (sys_metric_base and sys_metric tables).

Three new tools in `src/servicenow_mcp/tools/metric_tools.py`:

- **`list_metric_definitions`** — lists metric definitions from `sys_metric_base`;
  filters by name (substring), table, metric_type, and active flag; paginated,
  ordered by name.
- **`get_metric_definition`** — retrieves a single metric definition by sys_id
  or exact name (auto-resolved via name= lookup); 404/empty-result guards.
- **`list_metric_values`** — lists metric value records from `sys_metric`;
  filters by metric_definition (sys_id or name, auto-resolved), table_name,
  record_id, and date range; paginated, ordered newest-first by default.

All three tools registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
